subject.title: feat(android): add Wear real-time Talk controls

question: Should this phone-owned real-time Talk implementation become the next bundled Wear OS stage, including its new Gateway/provider contract surface?
rationale: The merged proxy establishes a safe architectural foundation, but this PR chooses a substantial bundled watch UX and public protocol shape that cannot be accepted solely from implementation correctness.

options.title: Sponsor the Wear stage
options.body: Approve the bundled Wear real-time Talk direction, remove or wire the ineffective client-language parameter, and land after exact-head validation.

options.title: Narrow the protocol change
options.body: Keep the Wear `talk.session` implementation but remove unrelated `talk.client.create` language exposure and defer broader client API support.

options.title: Pause bundled publication
options.body: Hold this PR until Wear release ownership, supported UX, and permanent protocol boundaries are explicitly defined.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Wear stage
recommendation.body: Approve the bundled Wear real-time Talk direction, remove or wire the ineffective client-language parameter, and land after exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged phone-proxy foundation and stated companion-app direction originate from this person’s recent Wear work.
